title: Raw local inverse through common stages and both Karoubi layers
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Index by its small directed poset of finite intermediate fields [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal A_E,\mathcal B_E$ be additive categories with additive transition functors $U_{M/E},V_{M/E}$, identity transitions literally identities, and specified natural associators with identity unit cases and the pentagon equation. Form the finite-stage categories $\mathcal A_E^+=\Kar(\mathcal A_E)$, $\mathcal B_E^+=\Kar(\mathcal B_E)$ with extended transitions, their common-stage pair categories $P_A,P_B$ of [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent], and their outer Karoubi envelopes [def-weil-karoubi-envelope]. No idempotent completeness of the raw categories is assumed.

Let $F_E,G_E:\mathcal A_E\to\mathcal B_E$ be additive functors, with specified natural comparison isomorphisms $b^F_{M/E}:V_{M/E}F_E\xrightarrow{\sim}F_MU_{M/E}$ and $b^G$ satisfying the unit and tower equations of [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent]. Let $\eta_E:F_E\Rightarrow G_E$ be natural transformations satisfying
$$\eta_MU_{M/E}\circ b^F_{M/E}=b^G_{M/E}\circ V_{M/E}\eta_E.$$
Use the Karoubi extensions $F_E^+(A,p)=(F_EA,F_E(p))$, $G_E^+$ likewise, $\eta^+_{E,(A,p)}=G_E(p)\eta_{E,A}F_E(p)$, the extended transitions $U^+_{M/E}(A,p)=(U_{M/E}A,U_{M/E}(p))$ and $V^+_{M/E}$ likewise, and the extended comparisons $b^{F,+}_{M/E,(A,p)}=F_M(U_{M/E}(p))\,b^F_{M/E,A}\,V_{M/E}(F_E(p))$ with inverse $V_{M/E}(F_E(p))\,(b^F_{M/E,A})^{-1}F_M(U_{M/E}(p))$, and $b^{G,+}$ likewise; these satisfy the unit, tower and compatibility equations above. Use the descended functors $\overline F,\overline G:P_A\to P_B$ and transformation $\overline\eta$, followed by their outer Karoubi extensions $\widehat F,\widehat G,\widehat\eta$.

Fix $A\in\mathcal A_E$ such that $a=\eta_{E,A}$ has a two-sided inverse $v$ in the raw category $\mathcal B_E$, and let $p:A\to A$ be any idempotent. Put $Q=(E,(A,p))\in P_A$ and $w=F_E(p)vG_E(p)$. Then $\widehat\eta$ is invertible on every object $(Q,q)\in\Kar(P_A)$, with $q$ any pair-category idempotent, and its inverse is precisely the outer Karoubi arrow with underlying pair morphism
$$\overline F(q)\,[E,w]\,\overline G(q).$$
The corresponding forward arrow is $\overline G(q)[E,G_E(p)aF_E(p)]\overline F(q)$. Their composites are $\overline F(q)$ and $\overline G(q)$, the actual Karoubi identities. In particular this applies with both $p$ and $q$ identities, using only the raw inverse $v$.

For every $M\supseteq E$, $\eta_{M,U_{M/E}A}$ is invertible with inverse
$$v_M=b^F_{M/E,A}\,V_{M/E}(v)\,(b^G_{M/E,A})^{-1}.$$
On the identity-projector object $Q_0=(E,(A,1))$, the same descended component is represented at $M$ by
$$[M,(b^G_{M/E,A})^{-1}\eta_{M,U_{M/E}A}b^F_{M/E,A}],$$
and its inverse by $[M,(b^F_{M/E,A})^{-1}v_Mb^G_{M/E,A}]$, with the displayed raw arrows included by identity idempotents at stage $M$. These classes are independent of $M$, including $M=E$, and of the chosen raw inverse. If $t:(Q,q)\xrightarrow{\sim}R$ is any isomorphism in $\Kar(P_A)$, then
$$\widehat\eta_R=\widehat G(t)\widehat\eta_{(Q,q)}\widehat F(t)^{-1}$$
has inverse $\widehat F(t)(\widehat\eta_{(Q,q)})^{-1}\widehat G(t)^{-1}$. Thus isomorphic presentations give the same component after the specified endpoint identifications. Invertibility is required only at the displayed raw object, not at every object of every stage.
